crossRefs.note: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
“You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to…
Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence…
to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an…
Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with…
This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and…
Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads.…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…
Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will…
For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into…
For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed…

translations.web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
translations.bsb: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
translations.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
translations.asv: And he brought forth his people with joy, And his chosen with singing.
